{{Combat}} [[Maras'ethil]] | affiliation = [[Moonhoof tribe]], [[Moro'gai tribe]], [[Tideblade]], [[Fallen Ones]] | loc = Northeastern [[Northern Kalimdor]] }} '''Moonwhisper Coast''' is a region located to the north of [[Azshara]]. Clad in moonlit splendor, this stretch of [[Kaldorei]] land is as mysterious as it is bewitched. Spirits of forlorn Highborne haunt the abandoned elven ruins and alien magic permeates the blue forests of this humid shore. An unbound land only a few would willingly call their home, yet it became such a haven for the wandering [[Tauren]] Tribe of the [[Moonhoof tribe|Moonhoof]], now holding watch over the azure expanses of the chaotic Moonwhisper Coast. ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-MoonwhisperCoast.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Moonwhisper Coast.]] {{clrl}} {| class="fandom-table" |- ||[[Ancestral Grounds]] • [[An'she's Respite]] • [[Blackroot Hold]] ([[Maw of Ursol]]) • [[Blackroot Village]] • [[Foulheart Sanctum]] • [[Grove of the Moon]] • [[Lunarclaw Den]] • [[Maras'ethil]] • [[Moonhoof Retreat]] • [[Moonhoof Village]] • [[Moonsilk Hollow]] • [[Narvalis Point]] • [[Riverhorn Village]] • [[Ruins of Nendis]] • [[Servitor's Sanctuary]] • [[Shimmerstar Lake]] ([[Moro'gai Village]]) • [[Shrine of Blazes]] • [[Shrine of Crags]] • [[Shrine of Cyclones]] • [[Shrine of Tides]] • [[Starshard Cradle]] • [[Sunsworn Camp]] • [[Timbermaw Hold]] • [[Tyrandas]] ([[Elun'aran]] • [[Grove of the Sun]] • [[Temple of Elunaris]] • [[Withered Enclave]]) • [[Vysnagosa's Rest]] • [[Whispering Shores]] |- || '''Undisplayed locations'''
